facts.fact: The NIA Executive Secretary said fingerprints collected in the 2021-22 SIM re-registration were never used to verify or authenticate SIM owners against the NIA system.
The NIA said work was under way on a new framework identifying SIM cards by linking them to the Ghana Card, to address payment fraud.
